Round 5 re-runs it per the Lightricks model card (https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.3-22b-LoRA-Cinemagraph). Corrections vs round 4: (1) TRIGGER WORD 'CINEMAGRAPH_MOTION' prepended to every prompt (card mandates it; round 4 omitted it entirely). (2) NON-DISTILLED endpoint fal-ai/ltx-2.3-22b/image-to-video/lora -- the LoRA's base_model in the card metadata is Lightricks/LTX-2.3 (full, non-distilled); round 4 used the /distilled endpoint whose forced distill-LoRA second pass fights the cinemagraph LoRA and hides the card's CFG/STG/steps knobs. Round 5 motion = PARTICLES ONLY (drifting dust/ash motes, thin smoke wisp, steam), device geometry explicitly static, glow/light/fire/emissive added to the NEGATIVE prompt.

jobs.what_frames_show: At training length the button glyphs stay LEGIBLE (play/pause, rewind, ff, screen, equalizer all intact), the gauge holds, only minor gear shimmer; steam + dust particles present, no glow. The single config where correct usage genuinely worked -- and it worked because num_frames matched the LoRA's 25-frame training length. Caveat: 1.04s raw (ping-pong looped to 2.08s); short for an ambient loop. Loop seam 1.54.

central_finding: The dominant correct-usage lever is num_frames = training length (25). The LoRA is trained on 25-frame clips; running 121 frames (rounds 3-5) pushes far outside distribution and drift/hallucination accumulate over the clip. The trigger word + non-distilled endpoint improve motion fidelity but make the model generate MORE aggressively, which HURTS on dark/low-detail subjects (diablo hallucinated a whole new glowing device). Correct usage IMPROVED steam (25f clean, 121f keeps legible buttons vs round-4's blank dials) but WORSENED diablo vs round 4. Seedance 1.0 pro fast (round 2) remains the identity-preservation champion on both skins, but its diablo motion was rune-glow (now banned) and its non-glow particle behavior on dark subjects is untested under the new constraint.
